data.name: SourceTables
data.value: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name

data.name: SourceColumns
data.value: SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info($table) ORDER BY cid

data.name: TargetColumns
data.value: SELECT column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name=@table ORDER BY ordinal_position

data.name: Lock
data.value: SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(@key); SET CONSTRAINTS ALL DEFERRED;

data.name: BackfillValidity
data.value: INSERT INTO question_validity_events(effect_id,material_id,kind,version_id,known_ticks) SELECT i.effect_id,i.material_id,'invalidated',i.version_id,COALESCE(t.known_ticks,0) FROM question_invalidations i LEFT JOIN question_invalidation_times t ON t.effect_id=i.effect_id AND t.material_id=i.material_id ON CONFLICT(effect_id,material_id,kind,version_id,known_ticks) DO NOTHING
